chain.text: GAO attributes lead-ship cost growth to technology development, design and construction, compounded by an optimistic budget estimate.

The Navy negotiated 18 percent fewer labor hours for CVN-79 than CVN-78, twice the Nimitz-class reduction and close to 9 million hours, which GAO calls unprecedented in 50 years of carrier construction. Its cost cap then rose from $11,398M to $12,936M.
chain.src: GAO-17-575, p.2 and p.24; CVN-79 cap history

chain.step: CVN-80 and CVN-81 inherit the assumption and the data problems
chain.text: One contract covers two hulls: the CVN-80/81 detail design and construction contract, awarded January 31, 2019. One budget line covers two hulls: CVN-81 draws $1,429.682M from line 2001. One number names two hulls: $13,529M is CVN-79's reported new baseline and CVN-80's baseline.
chain.src: CVN 78 MSAR FY2027, p.8 and p.10; SCN book PB2027, p.137

chain.step: What the pilot found recurs on every program
chain.text: A contract number is not a hull key, a budget line is not a hull key, award-level outlays cover under 1% of obligations, and capitalized value will never equal program cost. Each is in the variance or gap register with its evidence, ready for the next program.
chain.src: Ring 0 dossier, Parts I and N

steps.title: Load the public record
steps.do: The program's MSAR, budget justification books and GAO reviews go into a Unity Catalog volume.

steps.title: Map each document
steps.do: Find the cost exhibits and report sections without reading every page.
steps.out: Exhibit and section page ranges by budget line
steps.proof: Every P-5c, P-8a, P-35, P-27 and P-10 in the PB2027 SCN book

steps.title: Read and tie out
steps.do: Rebuild each table with exact decimals and check every subtotal and total.
steps.out: Tables usable as arithmetic, or a named failure
steps.proof: 7,743 of 7,746 tie-out checks pass over 34 PDFs; the 3 left are within rounding

steps.title: Build the key set
steps.do: Contract numbers and cost-reporting status from the MSAR's contract section; appropriation, line and program element from the budget book.
steps.out: A key set for the program

steps.title: Generate the program's server
steps.do: Pull contract actions for the key set into Unity Catalog; the Creator designs, reviews, generates and deploys a server over them.
steps.out: A tested server owned by the requester
steps.proof: The ops server: 7 tools, golden set of 17

steps.title: Investigate the records
steps.do: Attribute each incomplete record and name what is missing.
steps.out: Ranked cases with citations and collection requests
steps.proof: Attribution raised from 42.2% to 75.8% of the hull

steps.title: Govern every figure
steps.do: Route each candidate figure through the gate; register variances and gaps with owners.
steps.out: Verified figures, leads and owned questions

steps.title: Watch and deliver
steps.do: Probe each server every 15 minutes; publish pages, agents and Genie Code skills.
steps.out: Monitoring evidence and a product leaders can read
